usage: A common noun for TV news as a program or news segment; it is used very naturally in everyday Hong Kong Cantonese.
Can be used with verbs like 睇, 聽, 睇埋, or for describing what you watch on TV in the evening.
Neutral and everyday in tone; suitable for both casual conversation and general media-related writing.
Learners often use it when talking about news on television, especially when comparing 電視新聞 with other news sources like 網上新聞 or 電台新聞.
